Senses.Explanation: An eighty-year-old man entering the examination hall undertakes a consequential public test at an age when it cannot be dismissed as children’s play. Chan masters use the couplet to mark the gravity of a case, an address, or the claim to decide the matter for oneself. Dahui Zonggao caps Deshan’s bowl case with the old man in the examination hall and says it is no child’s game. Yinyuan Longqi compares the matter directly to the same late examination. Tianyin Yuanxiu uses the line in verse after “the dead person comes back to life.” Shending Yikui warns his assembly with the couplet if the preceding military images remain unclear.
